name: Repaired 5-qubit computational-basis measurement helper
task_prompt: Repair a computational-basis measurement helper for 5-qubit statevectors measuring qubit 4. The old code raises whenever p(1) is exactly zero or one, renormalizes with the wrong branch probability, and mutates its input. Implement deterministic and stochastic outcomes correctly, accept an injected numpy.random.Generator, return outcome, collapsed copy, and probability, and reject only invalid states or impossible forced outcomes. Add exhaustive basis-state tests and seeded Born-frequency tests with Wilson-interval assertions. Provide only complete executable Python code. Do not use remote services. Seed random generators, print the requested quantities, and include robust self-tests rather than relying on visual inspection.
